info.title: Primus Portal Execution Live Full API
info.description: SGP Live Full read contract composed from the local Live projection. Broker values remain suppressed on missing or mismatched reconciliation; production commands remain inactive.

parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: Fixed Live panel only. Advances that panel; all other panels return their first page. Same independent Live/Alpha/Account current-authority flight. Account panels remain ACCOUNT grain, not deployment economics.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque Portal lps2 continuation from this exact panel under the SAME deployment/workspace/profile/session/current scope and immutable retained snapshot. Requires panel. Never a source cursor; no source or authority selection. Expired/changed-view cursor is refused; restart this panel from its first page.

get.description: Sticky current Core preserves legacy separately. SCOPED_V2 is the exact DEPLOYMENT/LIVE source-only reader under independent governance.live.read, original Alpha/Account purposes and exact reviewed fields. Before retained reads, after every purpose, after snapshot equality and at LAST Core, the SAME combined flight retains all current obligations for body and held errors. No Canary/root lookup or fallback, source/broker acceptance, stream, activation, command, mutation, synthetic total or global population claim. Panel/source clock absence remains typed; Portal observed time is not source freshness.
